newsitem.title: UK: Mowlem SGB charge will not hit cash, funds.
newsitem.headline: Mowlem SGB charge will not hit cash, funds.

text.p: British construction group John Mowlem and Co Plc said on Thursday an expected charge related to the placing of shares in SGB Group Plc would not affect cash balances or shareholder funds.

"The profit and loss account will reflect a charge of 37.1 million stg representing the reinstatement of the goodwill previously written off when Mowlem originally purchased SGB in 1986. This reinstatement, required under current accounting standards, will, however, have no effect on the level of cash balances or of shareholders' funds," Mowlem said in a statement.
Mowlem plans to place a 49 percent stake in SGB, a supplier of access products and services, and retain 51 percent.
